title: Injective component map for tensor quotients
statement: For a Noetherian finite algebra S over R, a prime p of R, and n>0, the quotient tensor product (R_p/m^n) tensor_R S admits an injective R-linear map to the product over primes q over p of the corresponding localized quotients, carrying pure tensors to localized products.

proof.text: Use the Artinian product decomposition of the finite quotient algebra and localization at its maximal ideals; the resulting product map is injective and has the stated pure-tensor formula.
